findings.claim: The stick's launcher (deploy/launcher.sh, copied as install) is not signed: a swapped stick can carry another launcher, key and bootstrap and show the genuine fingerprint; the paper code protects only an honest launcher, and RUNBOOK section 1's longer form (key out of band) stays the stronger check
deploy/bootstrap.sh ended with exec, so its EXIT trap never ran and every run left its temp folder, with the unpacked host tree, behind; fixed in HS-1
A bare machine with no Docker still stops in deploy/box-install.sh with a message that names box-prepare.sh with --pub; design row 53's second half is not removed by HS-1
RUNBOOK section 1 (docs/runbook/01-install-a-new-site.md) still writes only the long first command; the one command is not on the runbook page
The fingerprint's form (the first 24 hex digits of the sha256 of the key's DER form) was chosen in HS-1 without a decision
